page.overview:
Who is Amazon?

Amazon is an elderly resident of Skypiea who was previously the inspector of the Heaven's Gate. She let people into Skypiea even if they could not pay her extol toll, but purposely failed to tell those who did not pay about the consequences for entering the city.

After the timeskip, she became the admission ticket saleswoman for Skypiea's new theme park, Wagomuland.

Amazon is a short very elderly woman with an extensively wrinkled face. She has purple hair, put into two buns. She has thin arms, and wears a pink tunic, and has small white wings on her back like all Skypieans.

After the time skip, Amazon has part of her hair put into two buns, and part hanging down. She is also wearing lipstick.
